# Our Learning Portal

> Booking and invoicing portals for session businesses in Hong Kong and Singapore: tutoring, learning centres, sports schools, language schools, STEM/coding/robotics, phonics, music and dance.

## What we do

Our Learning Portal designs and builds custom web portals for session businesses. Each portal is built around how the practice actually runs, not adapted from a generic template, and not a per-seat SaaS subscription.

The portal covers three views:

- **Parent portal** - upcoming class schedule, self-service rescheduling and cancellation, booking history, invoice viewing
- **Teacher portal** - weekly teaching schedule, availability submission, payslip viewing
- **Admin portal** - student and enrolment management, class calendar, invoice generation that pushes to Xero, teacher roster and costs, expense tracking

## Who it is for

- Tutoring practices (one-to-one and small-group)
- Learning centres (term-based programmes, multiple classrooms)
- Sports schools (squads and tiers, coach management, term fees)
- Language schools (Mandarin, English, phonics)
- STEM, coding and robotics programmes
- Music and dance studios

Primary markets: Hong Kong and Singapore.

## Key differentiators

- Bespoke build, shaped to each client's programmes, pricing and workflows
- Replaces WhatsApp-based rescheduling, spreadsheet invoicing and fragmented admin tools
- Invoices push to Xero
- One-off build fee plus a monthly platform fee as little as HK$1,500/month. No per-seat pricing
- Studio with offices in both Hong Kong and Singapore (same timezone, real conversations)

## Pricing model

A one-time build fee to design and configure the portal, plus a monthly platform fee as little as HK$1,500/month. No per-seat licences.
